subject: literacy
concept: Identifying an author's use of statistics or data and evaluating whether the numbers are presented fairly
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Truth Seeking Pillar and Grade 8 Math statistical reasoning — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student examines a realistic data presentation and identifies whether context (sample size, timeframe, comparison baseline) is missing
exercise.abstract: Student explains what additional context would be needed to fully evaluate a described statistic

misconception_flags: accepts a cited statistic as fully meaningful without questioning what context might be missing

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
